purpose: Teach: 高まり/渡さ/覆わ/広まっ/害する/根ざし/崩す/利か

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、注目度の高まりを論文で扱っていましたね
lines.en: Ren, you were writing about the concept of growing attention in your paper, weren't you?
lines.style: Warm, encouraging. Slight upward lilt on his name—drawing him in. Paced to give him room to answer. Genuinely curious about his work.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、文化を渡さない政策を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I wrote about policies that don't allow cultural transfer.
lines.style: Measured and careful. A slight hesitation before diving in—choosing his words precisely. Quiet but present. Almost as if checking himself for accuracy.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 森に覆われた地域を論文で扱っていましたね
lines.en: And you were examining forested regions in your research, I remember?
lines.style: Gentle, inviting him deeper. A light touch of recognition—showing she's been listening. Slow tempo. Genuine interest without pressure.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、世界に広まった俳句を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I focused on haiku and how it spread across the world.
lines.style: Steady and earnest. A small breath before the main thought. Speaking as if the idea matters and deserves care. Quiet conviction.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 環境を害する行為を論文で扱っていましたね
lines.en: And you also wrote about environmentally harmful practices, correct?
lines.style: Attentive, engaged. A note of seriousness enters—this topic carries weight. Not lecturing, but present. Watching to see how he'll respond.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、地域に根ざした文化を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, my focus was on culture rooted in specific regions and communities.
lines.style: Assured this time. A touch more grounded. Not hesitant—he knows what he's saying matters. Slight emphasis on 'rooted,' like the word itself is important.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 社会通念を崩す思想を論文で扱っていましたね
lines.en: So you explored ideas that challenged conventional social thinking?
lines.style: Thoughtful, measured. A reflective pause before speaking. Curious about how far his thinking goes. Warm but serious—respecting the weight of his ideas.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、規制が利かない海域を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I examined unregulated waters—areas where governance can't reach.
lines.style: Final thought. Quieter, as if closing a door carefully. Confident in what he's saying. A slight downward lean to the voice—wrapping up his point.
